title: [rereview] project-LICHEN-da2q.16.3: spec/02a-coordinated-capacity.md line 85 says XOR but test vectors and C link_ctx.c use CONCAT
description:
**Severity: P2 (spec error misleads implementers)**

Spec  says:
> Slot ID = hash_32(EUI64 XOR epoch) % num_slots

But:
- The test vectors () specify  — CONCAT, not XOR
- The C  implementation uses CONCAT (12-byte buffer: eui64 || epoch LE)
- The Python  uses CONCAT
- The Python  and C  use different XOR variants (inconsistent with each other and with the spec text)

The spec text should be corrected to say:
> Slot ID = hash_32(EUI64 || epoch) % num_slots
where || denotes concatenation of the 8-byte EUI64 with the 4-byte epoch in little-endian byte order.

**Files:** spec/02a-coordinated-capacity.md:85
